findings.title: Unsafe Fallback to Default Tenant
findings.issue: When JWT brand claim is missing, code falls back to 'realtutorialhub' tenant instead of rejecting access. Violates selected policy: 'Unknown provenance denies access.'
findings.consequence: Malformed or legacy JWTs without brand claim are granted implicit realtutorialhub access, bypassing multi-tenant isolation.
findings.requiredFix: Replace fallback with explicit rejection: if (!(auth as any).brand) throw new ForbiddenError('JWT brand claim required')

findings.title: Enforcer Fallback Violates Policy
findings.issue: Enforcer function defaults to 'realtutorialhub' when tenant parameter is missing, allowing routes to bypass tenant qualification silently.
findings.consequence: API routes that omit tenant parameter will use wrong tenant context, bypassing isolation.
findings.requiredFix: Make tenant mandatory: if (!user.tenant) throw new ForbiddenError('Tenant context required')

findings.title: Missing Tenant Verification in Enforcer Signature
findings.evidence: user: { userId: string; roles: Role[]; tenant?: string; ... }
findings.issue: Enforcer signature allows tenant to be optional (tenant?: string), inviting callers to omit it despite being required by FND03 policy.
findings.consequence: Downstream API routes can call enforcer without tenant parameter, relying on unsafe fallback.
findings.requiredFix: Change signature to tenant: string (required, not optional)

findings.title: Integration Guidance Incomplete
findings.issue: Integration guidance shows example pattern but provides no enforcement requiring downstream routes to migrate. Old signature still callable.
findings.consequence: Existing routes continue using old pattern with unsafe fallback instead of failing.
findings.requiredFix: After fixing BLOCKER-3, verify TypeScript compilation fails for old pattern. Document breaking change and migration checklist.

findings.title: Missing JWT Brand Claim Validation
findings.issue: Guard extracts brand using type assertion without validating brand claim exists. If JWT decoded but brand undefined, fallback assigns wrong tenant.
findings.consequence: Invalid JWTs silently get default tenant instead of 401 rejection.
findings.requiredFix: Add explicit validation before ownership check and return 401 if brand missing.

findings.title: Migrations Not Applied to Any Environment
findings.evidence: Section 8.1 checklist shows migrations generated but not applied to dev/staging
findings.issue: Schema changes exist only in SQL files. No evidence migrations executed against any database.
findings.consequence: Tests pass with mocks but actual database schema does not support tenant columns.
findings.requiredEvidence: Migration execution logs, database introspection output, query plan analysis

findings.title: No Integration Tests with Actual API Routes
findings.evidence: Section 8.1: Integration tests pending downstream implementation
findings.issue: All 18 tests are isolated unit tests. No tests demonstrate actual API routes consume tenant-aware enforcement.
findings.consequence: Cannot verify end-to-end tenant boundary enforcement in real request flow.
findings.requiredEvidence: At least one e2e test with JWT brand claim attempting cross-tenant access and receiving 403
